name: Sound clue
description: A hidden chime source that plays three chimes in order, one second apart (by default), when its button is pressed: the listening half of a bell-tower puzzle. Put the source behind a wall and the button where the player can reach it; the chimes come from the source, so they are muffled and panned by the audio engine, and with sound captions on each shows as text with its direction, for example [High chime, left].

spacing.description: Seconds between one chime and the next.

inputs.name: listen
inputs.description: The button; pressing it while the chimes play does nothing.

outputs.name: playing
outputs.description: On from the press until the last chime has sounded.
